principle: Known failures may be repaired automatically only by previously verified, bounded actions. Unknown failures stop publication and preserve the last verified archive.

signals: daily update exceeded its bounded runtime
actions: prepare candidates in batches of 15
stop enrichment as soon as the tab reaches 15 valid items
preserve strict localization and insight validation
incidents.onFailure: restore snapshot and report the slow stage

signals: Daily static archive did not reach the target
actions: exclude only dates before today from novelty history so same-day retry candidates remain reusable
retry daily update once with the bounded recovery candidate pool
accept documented craft cases only when the summary contains a concrete making decision, evidence language and at least two transferable creative signals
keep the strict source cap at 3 and allow the verified up-folder fallback cap of 6 only if the strict pass is underfilled
keep trust, Korean relevance and content-value gates active
re-export and verify
regenerate role-aware insights
re-export and verify
incidents.onFailure: restore snapshot and report unknown content defect

actions: discard today's invalid update items
refill only from candidates that pass creative-update-v1
re-export and verify
repair today's Korean Code article metadata
remove blocked page previews
re-export and verify
incidents.onFailure: restore snapshot and retain the last verified public archive

actions: validate titleKo, summaryKo and focusKo with the same degradation rules
discard only today's invalid localized items while keeping valid items
translate with the local qwen3:1.7b Ollama model
use remote providers only when the local service is unavailable
do not publish fallback-prefixed or prompt-leaking copy
re-export and verify
apply the shared canonical URL normalization to bookmark history
remove canonical duplicates
re-export and verify
incidents.onFailure: restore snapshot and require a new deduplication rule

actions: disable the Vercel CLI update notifier in the child process
retry only transient network or authorization failures
use bounded 15/30/45 second cooldowns with at most four total attempts
incidents.onFailure: stop further deployments and report authentication failure

signals: local recovery is verified but the public top date is stale
public tab count is not 15 after deployment
actions: treat local verification and public publication as separate states
verify all three public APIs up to six times during alias propagation
record a publication failure fingerprint if the public contract remains stale
incidents.onFailure: do not report success; preserve verified local data so the next publication run can redeploy without recollecting
